open.description:
Whether the picker is open. Bindable. It closes itself on Done and Cancel, on Escape and on a
click outside, and opens with the chosen items as `selected` says.

selected.description:
The values of the chosen items. Bindable. The picker works on a copy while it is open: Done
writes it back (in the order of `items`, keeping any value no item names), and Cancel and
dismissing leave it alone.

itemNoun.description:
What the items are called, plural, in the counter, the group counts and the empty state
("tools"). The counter reads "3 of 9 tools chosen".

searchLabel.description: Accessible name and placeholder of the search field.

collapseFrom.description:
How many selectable items it takes to switch to the long-list layout: the counter reads the
total ("42 tools"), and every group but the first starts collapsed under its sticky header.

loading.description:
Draw the loading state: three skeleton rows, after 300 ms, under the title and a live search
field. Nothing can be chosen until it is false.

loadingLabel.description: Announced politely when the loading placeholder appears.

noneChosenLabel.description:
Words on a group's header, after its count, when none of its items is chosen and something else
is. Skills and other groups that cannot be chosen from show their `note` instead.

emptyMetaLabel.description: Names the trailing column of an item with no `meta`, which draws an em dash.

emptyLabel.description: The line shown when there is nothing at all to choose from (no search involved).

noMatchHint.description: The line under the empty state's heading.

clearSearchLabel.description: Label of the button in the empty state that clears the search.

doneLabel.description: Label of the button that closes the picker and keeps the choices.

cancelLabel.description: Label of the button that closes the picker and drops the choices made in it.

class.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the dialog.

unsupportedProps.name: groups
unsupportedProps.description: The groups, in the order they should appear, with a note for a group that cannot be chosen from.

unsupportedProps.name: items
unsupportedProps.description: Everything that can be listed, in the order it should read within each group.

unsupportedProps.name: noMatchTitle
unsupportedProps.description: The heading of the empty state, given what was typed.

unsupportedProps.name: onCancel
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the picker is closed without keeping its choices: Cancel, Escape or a click outside.

unsupportedProps.name: onDone
unsupportedProps.description: Called with the chosen values when Done is pressed, after `selected` is updated.

unsupportedProps.name: triggerRef
unsupportedProps.description: The element focus returns to when the picker closes, usually the button that opened it.
